import argparse, hashlib, json, math, re
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter
import torch
from experiments.irstd_independent_v1.checks.s4_binding import verify_execution
from experiments.irstd_independent_v1.engine.checkpoints import require_exact
from experiments.irstd_independent_v1.engine.s4_checkpoints import identity, _bound_state, lr_for_update
from experiments.irstd_independent_v1.checks.s4_lineage import diagnostic_origin

def ck(ok, text):
    if not ok: raise ValueError(text)

def load(p): return json.loads(p.read_bytes())
def sha(p):
    d=hashlib.sha256()
    with p.open('rb') as f:
        for x in iter(lambda:f.read(1048576),b''): d.update(x)
    return d.hexdigest()
def json_id(item): return json.loads(json.dumps(item))
def read_complete(path):
    data=path.read_bytes()
    return data[:data.rfind(b'\n')+1].splitlines(keepends=True)

def inspect_run(run):
    p, lock=verify_execution(run)
    migration=p['migration']; k=migration['common_step']; first=k+1
    parent=run.parent/migration['parent_run_id']; pp=load(parent/'protocol.json')
    cp,cs=sha(run/'protocol.json'),sha(run/'execution_binding.json')
    op,osig=sha(parent/'protocol.json'),sha(parent/'execution_binding.json')
    ck((op,osig)==(migration['parent_protocol_sha256'],migration['parent_execution_binding_sha256']), 'parent locks')
    ck(k==600 and first==migration['first_new_step']==601 and p['seeds']==pp['seeds']==[46],'common boundary')
    schedule_path=run/'schedule_46.json'; sched=load(schedule_path)['updates']; ss=sha(schedule_path)
    ck(ss==sha(parent/'schedule_46.json')==p['schedule_sha256']['46']==pp['schedule_sha256']['46'] and len(sched)==36000,'schedule mismatch')
    modes=('Msep','Mraw','Mint'); details={}
    for mode in modes:
        o=identity(pp,mode,46,protocol_sha256=op,execution_sha256=osig)
        c=identity(p,mode,46,protocol_sha256=cp,execution_sha256=cs)
        pf=parent/mode/'seed46'; cf=run/mode/'seed46'
        contract=migration['modes'][mode]; receipt=load(cf/'migration_first_update.json')
        def chain(folder, ctx, expected_steps, upstream, read_steps):
            result=[]; kept={}
            for s in expected_steps:
                path=folder/'checkpoints'/f'step_{s:06d}.pt';side=path.with_suffix('.json')
                row=load(side); digest=sha(path)
                st=_bound_state(path,digest,ctx)
                ck(row['identity']==json_id(ctx) and (row['step'],st['step'],st['next_sample_index'])==(s,s,s),'chain identity or cursor')
                ck(digest==row['checkpoint_sha256'] and upstream==row['parent_checkpoint_sha256']==st['parent_checkpoint_sha256'],'checkpoint chain')
                result.append({'step':s,'checkpoint_sha256':digest,'sidecar_sha256':sha(side),'parent_checkpoint_sha256':upstream,'journal_prefix_sha256':st['extra']['journal']['sha256']})
                ck(st['extra']['journal']['updates']==s,'boundary row count')
                upstream=digest
                if s in read_steps: kept[s]=st
            return result,kept
        pchain,ps=chain(pf,o,[0,8,300,k],pp['initialization']['46']['sha256'],[k])
        ck(pchain[-1]['checkpoint_sha256']==contract['checkpoint_sha256'] and pchain[-1]['sidecar_sha256']==contract['sidecar_sha256'],'registered source')
        steps=sorted(int(path.stem.split('_')[1]) for path in (cf/'checkpoints').glob('step_*.json'))
        ck(steps==[k,first,*range(k+300,steps[-1]+1,300)],'missing or unordered child checkpoint')
        cchain,ch=chain(cf,c,steps,contract['checkpoint_sha256'],[k,first])
        a,b=ps[k],ch[k]
        for field in ('model','optimizer','rng','scheduler','runtime','step','next_sample_index','extra'):
            require_exact(a[field],b[field],mode+'/'+field)
        ck((o['evidence_runtime']['query_chunk'],o['evidence_runtime']['velocity_chunk'])==(64,8),'old chunks')
        expected=dict(query_chunk=256,velocity_chunk=81,checkpoint_chunks=True)
        ck({x:c['evidence_runtime'][x] for x in expected}==expected,'new chunks')
        ck(len(a['rng']['torch_cuda'])==1,'missing saved device RNG')
        ck(all(v['step'].item()==k for v in a['optimizer']['state'].values()),'parent Adam moments step')
        after=ch[first]
        changed=[name for name,z in b['model'].items() if not torch.equal(z,after['model'][name])]
        ck(changed and all(v['step'].item()==first for v in after['optimizer']['state'].values()),'first update did not advance AdamW')
        for state in [b,after]:
            ck(all(torch.isfinite(t).all().item() for t in state['model'].values()),'nonfinite model')
            ck(all(torch.isfinite(z[key]).all().item() for z in state['optimizer']['state'].values() for key in ('exp_avg','exp_avg_sq')),'nonfinite AdamW')
        raw=read_complete(cf/'updates.jsonl')
        with (pf/'updates.jsonl').open('rb') as stream:
            inherited=[stream.readline() for _ in range(k)]
        ck(raw[:k]==inherited and len(raw)>=steps[-1], 'child log incompatible with parent or committed step')
        points={row['step']:row['journal_prefix_sha256'] for row in pchain}
        for row in cchain: 
            if row['step'] in points: ck(points[row['step']]==row['journal_prefix_sha256'],'unequal shared root journals')
            points[row['step']]=row['journal_prefix_sha256']
        dig=hashlib.sha256(); ck(dig.hexdigest()==points[0],'step0 prefix'); counts=Counter()
        for step,line in enumerate(raw,1):
            z=json.loads(line); wanted=sched[step-1]
            ck(wanted['step']==z['step']==step and all(z.get(x)==v for x,v in wanted.items()),'unpaired actual schedule')
            ck(z['learning_rate']==lr_for_update(step) and z['finite_after_update'] is True and math.isfinite(z['total']), 'nonfinite row or wrong LR')
            counts[z['sample_role']]+=1;dig.update(line)
            if step in points: ck(dig.hexdigest()==points[step],'checkpoint journal digest')
            if step==first:
                ck(z==receipt['update'] and z['evidence_runtime']==expected and z['parameter_update_l2_by_module']
                    and any(v>0 for v in z['parameter_update_l2_by_module'].values()), 'first receipt/log discrepancy')
        ck(receipt['schedule_sha256']==ss and receipt['journal']==after['extra']['journal']
           and receipt['inherited_journal']==b['extra']['journal'] and receipt['inherited_journal']['sha256']==contract['journal_prefix_sha256'],'receipt schedule or prefix')
        ck((receipt['step'],receipt['source_step'],receipt['mode'],receipt['seed'],receipt['run_id'],receipt['source_run_id'])==(first,k,mode,46,run.name,parent.name),'receipt identification')
        ck((receipt['protocol_sha256'],receipt['execution_binding_sha256'],receipt['source_checkpoint_sha256'],receipt['root_checkpoint_sha256'],receipt['checkpoint_sha256'])==(cp,cs,contract['checkpoint_sha256'],cchain[0]['checkpoint_sha256'],cchain[1]['checkpoint_sha256']),'receipt provenance')
        origin,origin_sha=diagnostic_origin(run,p,mode,0)
        ck(origin==parent and origin_sha==op,'step0 provenance')
        g=load(cf/'progress.json')
        details[mode]={'tensor_states_bitwise_identical':['model','optimizer including all AdamW buffers','Python/NumPy/Torch CPU and saved CUDA RNG','scheduler','runtime','cursor','journal'], 'model_state_tensor_count':len(a['model']),'adamw_parameter_states':len(a['optimizer']['state']),'saved_cuda_rng_count':len(a['rng']['torch_cuda']),'parent_chain_through_migration':pchain,'child_committed_chain':cchain,'journal_prefix_identical_bytes':sum(map(len,inherited)),'journal_prefix_sha256':contract['journal_prefix_sha256'],'first_observed_update':first,'first_update_query_velocity_recompute':expected,'first_update_changed_model_tensors':len(changed),'first_update_receipt_sha256':sha(cf/'migration_first_update.json'),'first_update_seconds':receipt['update']['seconds'],'first_update_sample':{key:receipt['update'][key] for key in ('source','center','sample_role','core_xyxy')},'last_complete_journal_step_at_read':len(raw),'last_complete_journal_sha256':dig.hexdigest(),'last_committed_step_at_scan':steps[-1],'journal_role_exposure_at_read':dict(counts),'worker_progress_step_at_read':g['step'],'worker_phase_at_read':g['phase'],'inherited_step0_diagnostic_sha256':sha(pf/'diagnostics_0.json')}
    return {'schema':1,'status':'PASS','scope':'Immutable parent/child migration and a read-only, non-simultaneous per-model snapshot; no model forward pass or CUDA workload. Source of first-update runtime is the executed worker log and durable post-update tensors.','checked_utc':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),'device_used_for_audit':'CPU','run_id':run.name,'parent_run_id':parent.name,'parent_protocol_sha256':op,'parent_execution_binding_sha256':osig,'child_protocol_sha256':cp,'child_execution_binding_sha256':cs,'common_step':k,'first_new_optimizer_update':first,'seed':46,'model_modes':list(modes),'frozen_schedule_sha256':ss,'complete_schedule_slots':len(sched),'modes':details,'driver_state_at_read':load(run/'driver/state.json')}

if __name__=='__main__':
    ap=argparse.ArgumentParser();ap.add_argument('run_dir',type=Path);args=ap.parse_args()
    print(json.dumps(inspect_run(args.run_dir.resolve()),separators=(',',':'),allow_nan=False))
